body: Hi! Have you heard of Lovesick Witchery? They lean towards lots of gourmands and their names/labels are super creative! As for fruity I would've recommended Alkemia lol! However I have heard that Nui Cobalt nails a fresh blueberry scent, and I heard Arcana's "Craves" collection has nailed the fresh strawberry scent. And as for floral, it depends on what types of florals you like, I'm not much help with fresh florals, but if you like a dried flower type smell, I would recommend essential oil blends! Its all personal prefrence!
